🚨 UPDATE:

WELCOME TO OFFROAD MUDDING

A map built for the off road. Pickup trucks, semis, muscle cars, ATVs, tractors, boats and trailers, all running real mud physics that punish bad driving.

🏕️ THINGS TO DO
Run the mud pits with friends
Haul cargo with gooseneck and hauler trailers
Fuel up, set up camp, light a fire, turn on the radio
Cruise the trails and climb the mountains
And most importantly; roleplay

Built on depth over quantity. Every update comes from your
suggestions.

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite the game
